form.title: Internet line (SNMPv3)
form.enabled: Read the line speed over SNMPv3
form.enabledHint: ARCILOGGER reads the counters of the device's WAN interfaces; the speed shows on the Dashboard and on Live status. Only SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy (authPriv); v1/v2c are refused. The target is the source's own address.
form.userHint: The read-only user on the device; not a secret.
form.privHint: Not every device offers AES-256 (verify on site).
form.keyHint: 8–64 characters. Kept in the secret store; never sent to the browser or written to the configuration file or the logs.
form.linesHint: For each line, the interface name the device reports (ifName), at most 4 lines. The capacity is optional; when given, the speed is also shown as a share of it.
form.capacityHint: Capacities are whole Mbps (1–1,000,000); a line takes both or neither.
form.probeNote: On saving, ARCILOGGER connects to the device with these values and reads its interfaces; if that fails, nothing changes and the reason is shown in the request's steps. In strict outbound mode a new address or port is saved without the test, because its firewall rule opens only after ApplySystem.

errors.keyMissing: Both keys are needed while SNMP is on.
errors.network: SNMP cannot be switched on for a source whose address is a network: the target must be a single device address.
errors.capacityBoth: Download and upload are given together.
errors.noLine: Enter at least one WAN interface.
